overview.overview_description: Discover luxury living at Godrej Blue Tollygunge, Kolkata. Explore Godrej blue, your gateway to a modern lifestyle. Godrej blue Tollygunga offers spacious 4BHK, 3BHK flats in Kolkata. Nestled in the vibrant neighbourhood of Tollygunga, this project is designed to provide a holistic living experience. Let's explore what makes Godrej blue truly special. Find Godrej Properties in Tollygunga.

highlights.title: Prime Location
highlights.description: Situated on Diamond Harbour Road, Joka, with excellent connectivity to Behala, Thakurpukur, and Tollygunge.

highlights.title: Spacious Villas
highlights.description: Premium 3 BHK and 4 BHK villas with super built-up areas ranging from 1,811 sq. ft. to 3,601 sq. ft.

highlights.title: Peaceful Environment
highlights.description: Residents will enjoy everything they need, while also benefitting from a peaceful suburban environment.

highlights.title: Upcoming Metro Line
highlights.description: The upcoming Joka-BBD Bagh metro line is set to enhance connectivity, making commuting to central Kolkata seamless.

layout_and_floorplan.master_layout_description: At godrej Blue, luxury living is complemented by modern conveniences. The project is designed with an array of amenities, including a shopping zone within the complex, ensuring residents have easy access to daily necessities without leaving the community. Proximity to educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and markets adds to the convenience, making it an ideal place for families.

about.realty_description:
Godrej Properties Logo
The Godrej Group comprises a varied business portfolio that includes real estate development, fast moving consumer goods, advanced engineering, home appliances, furniture, security, and agri-care. While a large number of our businesses are privately held, the combined market cap of our publicly listed entities is in excess of USD 15 billion. Ranked as the 2nd most trusted Indian brand, with an annual revenue of USD 5 billion, and an estimated 1.1 billion customers across the world that use one or another Godrej product every day, the Godrej Group is amongst India's most diversified and trusted conglomerates.
about.group_description: Emami is a growth story of a dream that started with a humble beginning and transformed into a reality of a business behemoth. Founded by two friends in 1974, Shri. R.S. Agarwal and Shri. R.S. Goenka, Emami today has grown into one of the most trusted and loved brands of the nation. Emami Group, is a diversified business conglomerate which has revenue of approx 25000 crores spread across 8 key businesses generating employment of 25000 with global reach extending to 70 countries. Charting a dynamic growth path over the years, Emami has successfully established itself as a global brand with Indian values.

highlights.title: Floating Cafe
highlights.description: Experience the unique ambiance of the Floating Cafe, where you can unwind above tranquil waters. This inviting space features comfortable seating, panoramic views, and a relaxing atmosphere—perfect for enjoying coffee, conversations, or quiet moments surrounded by nature.

highlights.title: Private Paradise
highlights.description: Step into your Private Paradise—a serene retreat designed for relaxation and privacy. This exclusive area features lush surroundings, elegant furnishings, and tranquil views, making it the perfect spot to unwind, entertain guests, or enjoy quiet moments with family. Experience comfort and luxury in your own personal haven.

highlights.title: Holiday Destination
highlights.description: Enjoy the perfect family getaway in our Holiday Destination area. Designed for relaxation and fun, this space offers scenic views, comfortable lounging, and easy access to recreational activities.
